scope: Actual patcher CPU work on 32 stable large outputs and 384 tiny text updates per process. Three fresh alternating subprocess pairs per character scenario. Timing excludes final exact-content verification; natural GC can occur during measured work. Diagnostic GC is outside timing. This is not whole-app latency/RAM or a model-generation benchmark.

fieldNotes.outputCodeUnitsPerReply: Recorded after the final correctness-only output mutation; timed output is approximately 524288 code units depending on the scenario.
fieldNotes.retainedHeapDeltaBytes: Diagnostic post-GC heap delta after inserting bases; sources were materialized before the before-sample.
